entry.title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
entry.summary: Cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death in order to meet Jesus.

entry.title: Hiring jumps: The economy added 165,000 jobs last month
entry.summary: The U.S. job market improved last month, according to a report from the Labor Department Friday. Employers added more jobs than forecasters had expected and the unemployment rate dipped to 4.1%.

entry.title: 'He's got to go': Hakeem Jeffries calls for Hegseth's removal but stops short of impeachment
entry.summary: Speaking with Morning Edition, Hakeem Jeffries discussed ending the Iran war, holding Trump accountable and calls for new Democratic leadership, but offered few specifics on how Democrats would deliver.

entry.title: Fill in the blank in the quiz: Vance says they lost the midterms because of ____
entry.summary: Plus: Heidi Klum's hand, hackers and the pope's visitor!

entry.title: Why public schools nationwide are facing a massive drop in student enrollment
entry.summary: School enrollment was already expected to plunge by 2 million kids by 2030. Education experts say deporting immigrant families, many with school-age children, is making the crisis worse.

entry.title: After cancer surgery, Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV is kicking off a three-nation tour of Latin America with a visit to Uruguay, three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery that had put the entire trip into question.

entry.title: A judge blocks construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval
entry.summary: The Trump administration hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. But just after midnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.

entry.title: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
entry.summary: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.

entry.title: These are the races in the House and Senate that haven't been called yet
entry.summary: Democrats are poised to have a strong majority in the upcoming Congress. The final numbers are still being determined. Here's where things stand in the races that are waiting to be called by the AP.

entry.title: Melania Trump touts rare agreement she brokered between Russia and Ukraine
entry.summary: The six-day pause from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky comes as the administration ramps up efforts to secure an agreement to end the war in Ukraine.
